race.comment: THERMODYNAMIC (3) comes through a hot form race first up and while he didn't lead there, he should be able to land much handier over this trip. Expect Metcalfe to spear across early and give these plenty to worry about. Goes on top. HYSTERICAL LADY (9) continues to leave herself with too much to do but is hitting the line hard. Draws to go back again but if the pace is genuine she could round them up late. TERRITORIAN (10) put it all together stylishly last start at Murray Bridge when letting down strongly to win by 3.8L. Another drawn to get back and be warming late. EMBELLISHER (1) is mixing his form but has peaks that measure up, even more so with the 3kg claim.
